description: Strade agrosilvopastorali is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportale.regione.lombardia.it. The map service shows the routes classified as agro-silvo-pastoral roads, i.e. the road to the service of forests, pastures and agricultural land on the side, contained in the forest plans and closed to ordinary traffic, as it is not subject to the road code. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Agrosilvopastoral roads" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include agricoltura, foreste e uso del suolo, viabilità agrosilvopastorale. The listing shows 2026-04-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
